CHAOS Pixel Art Multi-Ratio（像素艺术多比率）

轻松将您的肖像照片转变为令人惊叹的像素风格艺术作品，并从 7 种经典长宽比中自由选择来创作独特的个性化作品！

主要特点：

标志性像素风格转换：利用精心调整的像素风格 LORA 模型，立即为您的肖像赋予生动、动画的外观，让人想起经典动画电影。

7 种宽高比可供选择：提供 7 种常用的宽高比选项，以满足各种显示需求：

选项 0：1:1（经典方形，非常适合社交媒体头像和帖子）

选项 1：16:9（宽屏，非常适合视频封面和水平显示）

选项2：4:3（传统显示比例）

选项3：1:2（垂直长格式，适合故事和一些移动显示）

选项 4：2:1（影院宽格式）

选项 5：3:4（垂直，适合人像特写和某些社交平台）

选项6：9:16（人像模式，适合短视频和手机壁纸）

智能画布扩展：当所选宽高比大于原始照片画布时，工作流程自动执行智能图像扩展，确保风格一致和自然的视觉延续。

可自定义图像高度：默认输出图像高度为 1024 像素（宽度根据所选比例自动计算），但您可以根据需要调整此参数以生成不同尺寸和分辨率的图像。

使用步骤：上传照片：单击上传按钮并选择您要转换的角色照片。为了获得最佳效果，我们建议使用清晰、光线充足的人物正面或半身照片。

选择纵横比：从提供的七个选项中选择您喜欢的纵横比（输入选项编号 0-6）。

调整参数（可选）：如果需要，您可以调整默认图像生成高度。

单击“运行”：确认设置后，单击“运行”按钮。

等待一代：请稍等片刻，皮克斯风格的 CHAOS 多帧工作流程正在为您打造风格独特的动画杰作！

提示和支持：

最终输出质量受原始照片质量、人物姿势和背景复杂程度的影响。

请随意尝试不同的照片和纵横比组合，以释放更多创意的可能性！

我们致力于不断优化我们的模型和功能——敬请关注更多令人兴奋的更新！

如果您遇到任何问题，欢迎加入我们的QQ群免费寻求帮助（QQ群：247228975）

CHAOS Pixel Art Multi-Ratio (Pixel Art Multi-Ratio)

Easily transform your portrait photos into stunning pixel-style artworks and freely choose from 7 classic aspect ratios to create unique, personalized pieces!

Key Features:

Iconic Pixel Style Conversion: Utilizes a finely-tuned pixel-style LORA model that instantly gives your portraits a lively, animated look reminiscent of classic animated films.

7 Aspect Ratios to Choose From: Offers 7 commonly used aspect ratio options to suit various display needs:

Option 0: 1:1 (Classic square, ideal for social media avatars and posts)

Option 1: 16:9 (Widescreen, great for video covers and horizontal displays)

Option 2: 4:3 (Traditional display ratio)

Option 3: 1:2 (Vertical long format, suitable for stories and some mobile displays)

Option 4: 2:1 (Cinematic wide format)

Option 5: 3:4 (Vertical, ideal for portrait close-ups and certain social platforms)

Option 6: 9:16 (Portrait mode, perfect for short videos and mobile wallpapers)

Smart Canvas Expansion: When the selected aspect ratio is larger than the original photo canvas, the workflow automatically performs intelligent image expansion, ensuring consistent style and natural visual continuation.

Customizable Image Height: The default output image height is 1024 pixels (width is automatically calculated based on the selected ratio), but you can adjust this parameter as needed to produce images of different sizes and resolutions.

Usage Steps:Upload Photo: Click the upload button and select a character photo you'd like to convert. For best results, we recommend using a clear, well-lit front or half-body shot of the person.

Select Aspect Ratio: Choose your preferred aspect ratio from the seven provided options (enter the option number 0-6).

Adjust Parameters (Optional): If desired, you may adjust the default image generation height.

Click Run: After confirming your settings, click the "Run" button.

Wait for Generation: Please wait a moment while the CHAOS Pixar-style multi-frame workflow精心 crafts a uniquely styled animated masterpiece for you!

Tips and Support:

The final output quality is affected by the original photo quality, character pose, and background complexity.

Feel free to experiment with different photo and aspect ratio combinations to unlock more creative possibilities!

We are committed to continuously optimizing our models and features—stay tuned for more exciting updates!

If you encounter any issues, feel free to join our QQ group for free assistance (QQ Group: 247228975)
